D01.event: IBM released preliminary Q2 2026 results ahead of its full report: revenue about $17.2B vs about $17.86B consensus; adjusted EPS $2.93 vs $3.02 expected. The stock fell about 25%, its worst day on record, and other software and IT-services stocks fell with it.
D01.financial_position: Profitable, investment grade, pays a dividend
D01.recent: Software (incl. Red Hat, HashiCorp) had been the main growth story through 2025
D01.tech: AI tailwind for infrastructure; investors fear AI disrupts traditional software and consulting

D02.event: OpenAI discontinued ChatGPT Atlas, its standalone AI web browser, less than a year after launching it in October 2025.
D02.financial_position: Heavy losses funded by large private raises
D02.recent: Launches many standalone products (browser, video app, devices plans) alongside ChatGPT
D02.tech: Strong AI tailwind; intense competition from Google, Perplexity and others in AI browsing

D03.event: Disney laid off a few hundred employees across divisions, mainly in HR and IT, with TV and studio divisions largely spared. It is the third round of job cuts at Disney in 2026.
D03.financial_position: Profitable; parks strong; streaming became profitable in 2025
D03.tech: AI tools emerging for back-office work; linear TV in decline

T01.event: Videndum issued a trading update guiding full-year adjusted EBITDA to £15–18M, below market expectations. It said H1 like-for-like revenue was broadly flat year on year. Shares fell about 35%.
T01.financial_position: Indebted after recent refinancing; thin margins
T01.geography: UK-listed; manufacturing in Italy and elsewhere; global customers
T01.industry: Equipment for content creators and broadcasters (camera supports, lighting, audio)
T01.recent: Has been restructuring and consolidating manufacturing sites
T01.tech: Creator-economy demand recovering slowly after 2023–24 slump

T02.event: JD Wetherspoon's pre-close update said full-year profits are likely to be below market expectations, its fourth profit warning in seven months, even though like-for-like sales grew about 4% in the 12 weeks to 19 July. Shares fell about 7%.
T02.recent: Opened and sold several pubs this year; known for low prices

T03.event: IG Group cut its 2026 outlook to mid-single-digit total revenue growth, well below market expectations, while reaffirming medium-term targets. Shares fell about 25%.
T03.industry: Online trading platform (CFDs, spread betting, OTC derivatives, share dealing, crypto)
T03.recent: Diversifying into US futures, crypto and share dealing
T03.tech: Retail trading boosted by volatile markets; new entrants in low-cost trading apps

T04.event: Vikram Solar reported Q1 FY27 profit after tax down about 85% year on year to ₹20 crore despite revenue growth. EBITDA margin fell to about 8% from 21% a year earlier. Shares fell about 10% to a 52-week low.
T04.financial_position: Rising debt and finance costs from capacity expansion
T04.industry: Solar module manufacturing, building cell capacity
T04.recent: IPO in 2025; expanding into cell manufacturing
T04.tech: Strong domestic solar demand and policy support

T05.event: After Q1 FY27 results showing strong loan and AUM growth and healthy profit, Muthoot Finance shares fell about 9% (intraday down 11%) and several brokerages downgraded the stock and cut targets.
T05.recent: Gold price rally in 2025–26 boosted gold-loan demand

T06.event: The day after Q1 FY27 results showing net profit up about 72% year on year to ₹1,037 crore, gross NPA improving to 3.25% and lower slippages, IndusInd Bank shares fell about 6%.
T06.recent: In 2025 disclosed accounting discrepancies in its derivatives book, leading to losses and senior management exits; new CEO since August 2025

T07.event: Fluence cut fiscal 2026 revenue guidance to about $2.4B from a prior midpoint of $3.0B and widened adjusted EBITDA guidance to a loss of about $200M from about $10M. It also appointed a new COO. Shares fell about 22% after hours.
T07.financial_position: Thin margins; near break-even before this update
T07.recent: Shifting supply chain toward US domestic content to qualify for tax credits
T07.tech: Strong storage demand from data centres and grid

T08.event: Sionna Therapeutics announced it will lay off almost half of its workforce and refocus its pipeline.
T08.industry: Cystic fibrosis drugs (NBD1 stabilisers, intended as add-ons to existing CFTR modulators)

T09.event: Relay, an AI workflow-automation startup founded in 2021, announced it is shutting down; paying customers lose access on 14 September. Its founder and some staff are joining Google's Chrome team.
T09.industry: AI workflow automation (no-code, positioned as an AI-native alternative to Zapier)
T09.recent: Founder previously sold a startup to Google in 2015
T09.tech: AI agents spreading rapidly across software

T10.event: Notion announced that Notion Mail, the AI-focused email client it launched in April 2025, will be shut down.
T10.recent: Launched AI agents inside its core workspace in 2025
T10.tech: AI agents spreading rapidly across productivity tools

T11.event: JLR announced it will cut about 4,000 roles (almost one in ten, mostly salaried and management, mainly UK) over two years, as part of a plan to save £1.7B and lower its break-even to about 300,000 vehicles a year.
T11.financial_position: Profitable in FY25; pursuing net-cash targets
T11.geography: UK, owned by India's Tata Motors; key markets US, China, UK
T11.ownership: Private subsidiary of a listed parent
T11.recent: A cyberattack in September 2025 halted UK production for about five weeks; Jaguar is being relaunched as an EV-only brand with no new models on sale until 2026; new CEO since late 2025

T12.event: Volkswagen's supervisory board approved a plan to cut a further 50,000 jobs (on top of 50,000 already agreed) and to drop about half of its model line-up. Shares rose on the news.
T12.financial_position: 2025 net profit fell 44% to €6.9B; 2026 operating margin guidance 4–5.5%
T12.recent: 2025 deliveries fell in China and North America
T12.tech: Industry-wide shift to EVs and software-defined cars

T13.event: Oracle laid off staff again, including about 8% of its Americas cloud infrastructure unit, with data-centre maintenance roles hit hardest. It said it would cut management layers and reduce 'micro-teams' by almost half.
T13.financial_position: Capex surged on multi-hundred-billion-dollar AI cloud contracts; free cash flow negative and debt rising
T13.recent: Signed very large AI compute contracts with OpenAI and others in 2025

T14.event: PB Fintech fell 36% in one session, its largest ever fall. Turtlemint, another listed insurance distributor, hit its 20% lower circuit, and insurers and other financials fell too.
T14.recent: Strong growth in health and term-insurance sales

T15.event: Zepto said it agreed a private share sale to existing investors and pushed back its planned IPO by about two to three quarters. It had filed its updated draft prospectus with SEBI on 8 June 2026.
T15.recent: Rapid dark-store expansion to over 1,100 stores
T15.size: Large (FY26 revenue ₹22,624 crore, roughly double FY25)
T15.tech: Quick commerce growing fast; listed peers Swiggy (Instamart) and Eternal (Blinkit)

T17.event: Datadog beat Q2 expectations and raised its full-year guidance. Shares fell about 21% that day.
T17.recent: Stock had roughly doubled in 2026 before the results

T18.event: After Q1 FY27 results showing revenue up 23% year on year to ₹4,717 crore and profit before tax up about 10%, but consolidated net profit down year on year, NLC India shares fell about 6.5%.
T18.recent: Recently commissioned the 1,980 MW Ghatampur thermal power project

T19.event: Uber announced about 3,300 job cuts (about 10% of its 34,000 staff), along with merging engineering and science teams and a return-to-office mandate.
T19.tech: AI and autonomous vehicles reshaping mobility

T20.event: Infosys reported Q1 FY27 revenue below expectations and lowered the upper end of its FY27 revenue growth guidance by more than expected; margins were stable and deal wins healthy. It also named a CEO-designate. Shares fell 2–3%.
T20.geography: India, clients mainly US and Europe
T20.tech: Generative AI changing how IT services are bought and priced

T21.event: Aurobindo Pharma disclosed a regulatory communication about Unit-I of its subsidiary Eugia Pharma, a formulation plant in Telangana that was inspected in February 2026. Shares fell about 2%.
T21.geography: India; major exports to the US
T21.recent: Another Eugia unit received an adverse regulatory classification in June 2026

T22.event: Ambuja Cements (Adani Group) reported Q1 FY27 net profit down about 34% year on year to ₹577 crore, and profit before tax down about 41%. Shares fell about 1%.
T22.recent: Rapid capacity expansion through acquisitions in 2023–25

T23.event: Dalmia Bharat reported Q1 FY27 volumes up 9% year on year to 7.6 million tonnes, ahead of the industry, but EBITDA down 9% year on year. Shares fell about 2.4%.
T23.recent: Completed acquisition of a 5.2 MTPA Central India cement asset during the quarter

T24.event: Celsius reported Q2 revenue of $817.9M (up 11% year on year) versus about $870–885M expected, and adjusted EPS of $0.36 versus about $0.41–0.43; gross margin was 48.1% versus 51.5% a year earlier. Shares fell 14–17%.
T24.financial_position: Profitable; took on debt for acquisitions
T24.industry: Energy drinks (Celsius, Alani Nu, Rockstar in the US)
T24.recent: Acquired Alani Nu and US rights to Rockstar Energy in 2025; stock down about 36% in 2026 before results
